usageClaims.meaning: The identified station or explicitly scoped facility equipment is positively confirmed for self-directed use, subject to recorded conditions.
Use is positively confirmed in coached instruction; this does not imply self-directed use.
Use is positively confirmed only as part of an identified program or class; this does not imply open or generally coached access.
No current publishable positive usage claim is present; this is not unavailability.

sourceClasses.limitations: A listing alone is not an exhaustive equipment, space, or usage inventory.
Omission is not negative unless the source is demonstrably enumerative and the protocol authorizes no-positive closure.
Evidence must be bound to the specific facility; a generic brand page cannot silently provide facility identity or inventory.
Must be facility-scoped or explicitly state the facilities to which the inventory applies; presence does not establish access.
Generic discipline descriptions do not establish facility-specific facts.
Program participation does not establish open use and must be facility-scoped.
A generic login or booking home without facility identity is insufficient. Authenticated or inaccessible content may be BLOCKED.
A dated schedule is volatile and does not establish open use or durable equipment presence by itself.
Facility identity, date, context, and currentness must be explicit; isolated imagery is not an exhaustive inventory.
Identity and object/space interpretation must be unambiguous; generic turf or floor imagery is insufficient for a station derivation.

stations.name: SkiErg

physicalRule.note: Presence establishes equipment and minimum physical feasibility, not permission or access.

publicClaims.practice: Requires a current station-scoped positive usage claim.
publicClaims.openPractice: Requires OPEN_USE_CONFIRMED scoped to SkiErg or an explicitly inclusive facility equipment set.

stations.sufficiencyProtocol: Positive closure requires current facility-bound SkiErg evidence. No-positive closure requires review of a sufficiently authoritative facility-specific enumerative equipment source set.

stations.sufficiencyProtocol: Positive closure requires sled, suitable lane, and association. No-positive closure requires equipment plus HYROX/training/space sources to be adequately reviewed.

auxiliaryDimensions.name: Running environment
auxiliaryDimensions.rule: Facts remain typed alternatives; none alone becomes full HYROX running-practice capability without explicit environment and usage scope.

freshnessComposition.rule: Each typed derivation fails closed independently when any required dependency is stale, unpublished, refuted, or source-invalid; sibling derivations remain valid if their own dependencies remain current.
